reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music experience in Provincia! No more jarring transitions between different music beds like day, night, and combat. Our new crossfade technique ensures a smoother listening experience, enhancing your immersion in the game. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
